title: Concept: Unix password database content served in a response
description: The root line of the Unix password database is the single most recognisable proof that a request escaped the web root: the `x` placeholder, uid and gid zero, the home directory and the login shell cannot be produced by an application that stayed inside its own content.
applicability: Responses served by a web server, framework or API that maps a client-controlled path to the filesystem.
risk: The caller has read arbitrary files outside the web root, which typically extends to configuration, credentials and private keys; the account list alone supports credential attacks on the host.
